inherits.scope: The HD63701V0 manual documents the same Hitachi timer and interrupt architecture; this profile states its distinct EPROM/RAM map, register reset facts, GPIO reset behavior, SCI framing rule, and operating modes locally.
restrictions: The current wrapper implements single-chip Mode 7 only.
The EPROM image is supplied through a read-only FPGA program interface; analog programming mode is not represented.
The contradictory Mode-7 address-error statements for 0040-007F remain undefined by documentation.
Standby clock shutdown and bi-phase/external-clock SCI modes remain outside the current digital claim.

operating_modes.mode7: single-chip operation with 192-byte RAM and internal F000-FFFF EPROM; implemented
operating_modes.prom_programming: external 27256-style EPROM programming mode with MCU functions stopped; analog programming interface is not implemented
operating_modes.other_modes: Modes 0, 1, 2, 5, and 6 are documented but outside the current wrapper
operating_modes.sleep: SLP stops CPU execution while peripherals continue; implemented by the shared HD6301 CPU profile
operating_modes.standby: STBY asynchronously stops clocks and enters reset with conditional RAM retention; not yet represented as an explicit input

memory_control.RAME: bit 6 resets set and enables physical 0040-00FF RAM; clearing it leaves those Mode-7 addresses without external memory
memory_control.STBY_PWR: read/write retained-supply validity bit normalized through standby_power_ok_i
memory_control.address_trap: RTL traps instruction fetches at 0000-003F and 0100-EFFF; the 0040-007F physical RAM conflict is explicitly unverified
memory_control.eprom: F000-FFFF is read-only during MCU operation and supplied through the program-image interface

implementation_scope.rtl: rtl/hd6301/hd63701v0_mcu.sv implements the single-chip Mode-7 digital boundary with a separately supplied 4-KiB EPROM image
implementation_scope.model: model/hd63701v0_device.py independently selects V0 RAM, SCI, timer, GPIO, program-memory, and address-error facts
implementation_scope.verification: model and RTL tests cover EPROM reset vectors, both RAM boundaries, the explicit ambiguous-range policy, unambiguous address TRAP, GPIO, FRC writes, OLVL reset, and V0 framing-error transfer
implementation_scope.excluded_modes: expanded modes, physical bus pins, analog EPROM programming, standby entry, bi-phase SCI, and external-clock SCI remain unclaimed
analog_exclusions: EPROM programming voltage and charge retention
